source='''def transform(grid):\n    # The 8x8 motif consists of four repeated/reflected 4x4 quadrants.\n    # Return its upper-left quadrant, excluding surrounding zero padding.\n    cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value != 0]\n    r0 = min(r for r, c in cells)\n    c0 = min(c for r, c in cells)\n    return [row[c0:c0 + 4] for row in grid[r0:r0 + 4]]\n'''
